subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Volkswagen's Emissions Scandal
description: A quick, practical guide to Volkswagen's Emissions Scandal.

hook.text: Volkswagen's cars passed emissions tests perfectly. On the road, they emitted 40 times the legal limit of pollutants.

buildup.text: VW installed 'defeat devices' — software that detected when a car was being tested and reduced emissions temporarily.

discovery.text: Researchers at West Virginia University discovered the discrepancy in 2014 using real-world road testing.

twist.text: The fraud wasn't one person's idea. Engineers, managers, and executives all participated over nearly a decade.

climax.text: VW paid over $30 billion in fines and settlements. Several executives went to prison. Culture enabled the fraud.

punchline.text: Passed every test. Failed on every road. Software cheated.

quiz.question: How did VW cheat on emissions tests?
options: Software detected testing and temporarily reduced emissions
